q1.explanationZh: chair 名词“椅子”，作动词“主持（会议）”，如 chair a meeting。

q2.explanationZh: chair“主持”+ man“人”= chairman“主席”，复数 chairmen。

q3.explanationZh: chalk“粉笔”，l 不发音；a stick of chalk“一支粉笔”。

q4.explanationZh: challenge 名词、动词同形“挑战”，形容词 challenging“有挑战性的”。

q5.explanationZh: champion 名词“冠军”，也可作形容词“冠军的”。

q6.explanationZh: champion 加 -ship 构成 championship“冠军称号”。

q7.explanationZh: chance 名词“机会”，by chance“偶然地”。

q8.explanationZh: change 动词“改变”，名词还可表示“零钱”。

q9.explanationZh: channel 名词“频道；途径”，注意结尾是 -nel。

q13.explanationZh: character 加 -istic 构成 characteristic“特征；特有的”。

q14.explanationZh: charge 名词“主管；费用”，动词“收费；控告”，be in charge of“负责管理”。

q15.explanationZh: charity“慈善；慈善团体”，复数 charities。

q16.explanationZh: charm 名词“魅力”，动词“迷住”，形容词 charming“迷人的”。

q17.explanationZh: chart“图表”，a sales chart“销售图表”。

q18.explanationZh: chase 动词、名词同形“追逐；追捕”。

q19.explanationZh: chat 动词、名词同形“聊天”，过去式 chatted。

q21.explanationZh: cheat 动词“欺骗”，名词还可表示“骗子”。

q22.explanationZh: check 动词、名词“检查”，check in“到达登记”。

q23.explanationZh: 由短语 check out“付账离开”合成名词 checkout“结账离开；付款台”。

q24.explanationZh: cheek“面颊”，注意双写 e，别和 check 混淆。

q25.explanationZh: cheer“使高兴；欢呼”，cheer up“振作起来”。

q28.explanationZh: chemical 名词“化学品”（常用复数 chemicals），形容词“化学的”。

q30.explanationZh: chemist 加 -ry 构成学科名 chemistry“化学”。

q31.explanationZh: cheque 是英式拼写“支票”，美式写作 check。

q32.explanationZh: chess“国际象棋”，play chess“下棋”，前面不加冠词。

q33.explanationZh: check in“到达登记；办理入住”，反义 check out。

q34.explanationZh: check out“结账离开”，名词形式 checkout。

q35.explanationZh: challenge sb. to ...“向某人挑战……”，to 后接名词。

q36.explanationZh: by chance“偶然地”，chance 前不加冠词。

q37.explanationZh: 在 by chance 中加 pure“纯粹的”，表示“纯属偶然”。

q38.explanationZh: chance 后接 to do，或接 of/for doing，表示“做……的机会或可能性”。

q39.explanationZh: Chances are that ... 句型表示“很可能……”，chances 用复数。

q40.explanationZh: take a chance“碰运气；冒风险”，手册中有冠词 a。

q41.explanationZh: change A for B“把 A 换成 B”，介词用 for。

q42.explanationZh: change for the better“好转”，change for the worse“恶化”，用比较级。

q43.explanationZh: be in charge of“负责管理”，主语是负责的人。

accept: be in sb.'s charge/in the charge of sb.
be in the charge of sb.

q44.explanationZh: be in the charge of sb.“由某人负责管理”，主语是被管理的事物，注意有 the。

q45.explanationZh: charge sb. with sth.“控告某人犯某罪”，介词用 with。

q46.explanationZh: in chase of“追赶着……”，chase 在这里是名词。

q47.explanationZh: cheer up“使高兴；振作起来”，既可及物也可不及物。

q48.explanationZh: write sb. a cheque for ...“给某人开一张……的支票”。

q49.explanationZh: cheer up“振作起来”，try to 后用动词原形。

q50.explanationZh: charge sb. with ...“控告某人……”，be going to 后用原形。

q51.explanationZh: “主要特征”用名词 characteristic，主语单数。

q52.explanationZh: this 后用单数名词，chance of ...“……的机会”。

q53.explanationZh: 离开酒店前要 check out“结账离开”，must 后用原形。

q54.explanationZh: 换电视“频道”用 channel，many 后用复数 channels。

q55.explanationZh: campus singer competition“校园歌手大赛”，competition 是“比赛”。

q56.explanationZh: “被骗”用被动语态 be cheated，are 后用过去分词。

q57.explanationZh: change for the worse“恶化”，is 后用现在分词表示正在恶化。

q58.sampleAnswer: Faced with challenges from online stores, the century-old store took a number of measures to turn the crisis into an opportunity, and finally achieved another success.
references: Faced with challenges from online stores, the century-old store took a number of measures to turn the crisis into an opportunity, and finally achieved another success.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “面对挑战”可用 be faced with challenges，“化危机为转机”译作 turn the crisis into an opportunity。

q59.sampleAnswer: This game, based on a classic Chinese novel, has exposed many foreign players to the charm of the East.
references: This game, based on a classic Chinese novel, has exposed many foreign players to the charm of the East.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “东方魅力”译作 the charm of the East，based on 作后置定语。

q60.sampleAnswer: The students are doing experiments in the lab with some new chemicals.
references: The students are doing experiments in the lab with some new chemicals.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “化学品”用复数 chemicals，“正在做实验”用现在进行时 are doing experiments。

q61.sampleAnswer: The charity fund was conducted to promote youth soccer in China.
references: The charity fund was conducted to promote youth soccer in China.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: charity fund“慈善基金”，“为了推广”用不定式 to promote。

q62.sampleAnswer: The victory revived glorious memories of his championship-winning days.
references: The victory revived glorious memories of his championship-winning days.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “夺冠岁月”可译作 championship-winning days，“勾起回忆”用 revive memories。

q63.sampleAnswer: With the development of technology, some of these supermarkets have installed the automatic checkout lanes for customers.
references: With the development of technology, some of these supermarkets have installed the automatic checkout lanes for customers.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “自动结账通道”译作 automatic checkout lanes，checkout 在这里作定语。

q64.sampleAnswer: This is the first time that I have been to a cyber-cafe, where people can surf and chat freely on the Internet.
references: This is the first time that I have been to a cyber-cafe, where people can surf and chat freely on the Internet.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: This is the first time that ... 后用现在完成时；where 引导非限制性定语从句。

q65.sampleAnswer: The money raised and the relief supplies are in the charge of the organizer, and then they will be sent to the disaster-stricken area soon.
references: The money raised and the relief supplies are in the charge of the organizer, and then they will be sent to the disaster-stricken area soon.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “由……管理”用 be in the charge of，主语是被管理的钱和物资。

q66.sampleAnswer: There is no doubt that the newly-released soap drama will be very popular, in which the characters all have a strong sense of humor.
references: There is no doubt that the newly-released soap drama will be very popular, in which the characters all have a strong sense of humor.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “角色”用 character 的复数 characters；“毫无疑问”用 There is no doubt that ...。

q67.sampleAnswer: What has been puzzling me is what I should do in order to cheer up the students who strive to improve their study but have met with repeated frustrations.
references: What has been puzzling me is what I should do in order to cheer up the students who strive to improve their study but have met with repeated frustrations.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “使……振作起来”用 cheer up sb./cheer sb. up；What 引导主语从句。
